rationale_one_line: oh-my-pi's own light theme (warm paper, deep-rose accent, dark terminal panels) rendered as a head-to-head duel that shows content-hash editing beating line-number editing.
writing_tone_notes: Precise, confident, unshowy. Short declaratives. A reverse-engineer's voice: anchor to content, distrust positions. Lowercase brand.
do_rules: lead the caption with the star metric, then the capability fact (hash-anchored edits)
let the split duel carry the argument; words only name it
keep every code panel dark (#100e18) on the warm paper canvas so light-canvas readability has solid coverage
one differentiator, named on screen: edits anchored to content, not line numbers
dont_rules: no terminal-tour / node-diagram-of-32-tools default (killed in the concept)
no fabricated numerals on screen (only the star count is double-sourced)
no per-cut swipe; foley click only on the lock
no dark wash - the light canvas answers the standing brightness complaint
